name: Maltese Championship 2026
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAxNzQ1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--417935762bfb96f37d3a4122e860cb7a459231ec/91697.jpg) Welcome to Maltese Championship 2026, the fourth official WCA competition in Malta! Whether you’re competing for the first time or returning for another competition, we’re excited to welcome you to our growing speedcubing community. Competitors from all countries are warmly invited to take part. While prizes and national titles are reserved for Maltese competitors, every participant will compete on equal terms and receive official WCA results. Our aim is to make Maltese Championship 2026 our biggest and most welcoming competition yet, bringing together cubers of all ages and experience levels for a memorable day of competition and community. Be sure to check all tabs, especially [if you are a new competitor](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026#76640-for-new-competitors). **Registration is only possible online through this website. Check the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026/register) section for details.** [T-shirts are available to order](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026#78743-championship-t-shirt-competitors-supporters) for competitors and supporters by the 6th September 2026.
